title: Compose live prepared h1 worker
objective: Execute the prepared h1 resident candidate and all final live class, compact-unit, torsion, honesty, and correspondence authorities in one worker without serialized or oracle intermediates

handoff.summary: Unified the resident candidate and live owner bridge into one compiled ownership domain, then composed exact relation-derived units, p2176 embedding/log replay, bounded regulator correspondence, class, honesty, compact provenance, and torsion into a deterministic correspondence-complete worker result.
risks: The four-ulp regulator corridor is pinned correspondence evidence for this qualified field, not general regulator certification.
The p2176 replay kernels remain separate addon calls after the unified candidate/bridge call; their inputs are copied in memory because addon buffer ownership is local.
next_steps: Integrate the adapter into the Outcome-C paired benchmark and run the authenticated cold replay outside the exclusive timer.
Generalize the unified ownership-domain compiler mechanism so callers do not need a mechanical wrapper signature.
